svg.text: MRCD-Net: Mask-aware Reliability-gated Consistency Distillation Network
Problem 2 - Robust Multimodal Sentiment Prediction under Local Contiguous Modality Missing
Teacher Theta_T frozen after Stage B full-modality view (no artificial missing)
Student Theta_S deployed for inference contiguous-missing view (30% complete views retained)
M = 1 only on originally-observed O=1 steps
never overwrite natural-zero Z or padding P
same zero -> different state embedding (observed / natural-zero / missing)
valid / obs / nat / miss / begin / mid / end / longest
dynamic gate g = softmax(eta(u,q) + gamma log rho_obs)
teacher sees full A/V -> balanced weights
z = LN([g*u_L; g*u_A; g*u_V; u_L*u_A; u_L*u_V; u_A*u_V])
low rho_obs on A/V -> gate automatically down-weights
dynamic gate g shifts weight to observed modalities
missing -> g_A, g_V decay; g_L rises (not hard-coded)
L_T = L_cls^T + l_r L_reg^T + l_c L_coh^T
early-stop on full valid -> freeze Theta_T
cached soft targets and hiddens for student
L_S = L_sup^S + l_kc L_KD-cls + l_kr L_KD-reg
+ l_f L_feat + l_rel L_rel + l_g L_gate
multi-metric: Acc / Macro-F1 / MAE / Pearson / Robust-AUC
temperature tau on valid set; monotonic regression bias
freeze student weights, scaler, masks, seeds; no test tuning
Robustness Analysis on Fixed Missing Grid
A / V / A+V (+ diagnostic L, L+A, L+V, all)
mixed-effects: Delta ~ b_g + b_p + b1 r + b2 r^2 + interactions
ablation: B0 text-only / B1 naive / B2 fixed-gate / B3 dropout /
B6 no-KD / B7 output-KD / B8 no-relation / B9 no-gate-KD
load frozen student, scaler, tau, calibration, aligned features
all-zero content positions treated as unavailable state
one forward per sample: no teacher, no label-based tuning
outputs: polarity in {Neg, Neu, Pos}, intensity in [-3,3], 3 probs
internal diagnostics: gate_L/A/V, detected A/V missing ratio
full-modality baseline: Accuracy / Macro-F1 / per-class F1 / MAE / Pearson
missing-view robustness: C_cls agreement, D_reg intensity drift
error attribution by label / length / missing pattern / teacher confidence
3-5 random seeds, mean +/- std; paired bootstrap vs baseline
student only ~5-7M params / FP32 ~20-28MB / FP16 ~10-14MB / INT8 optional
